novel.justification: Uniform-in-\(x\) outcome-sectional Hölder regularity is a deliberate, nonstandard primitive condition of this known-design benchmark. It is satisfied by separately smooth normalized conditional-density families, including bounded finite-dimensional exponential tilts whose outcome features are uniformly \(s\)-Hölder and whose covariate-dependent coefficients remain in a compact set. These families describe conditional distributions with uniformly regular outcome shapes across compact covariate strata, without requiring any mixed \((x,y)\)-derivative.
